name: OpenEden TBILL
notes: Tokenized T-Bill RWA vault. Official org OpenEdenHQ (github.com/OpenEdenHQ) contains only smart-contract and audit repos (openeden.vault.audit, openeden.smartcontract.audit, openeden.tbill.solana, ds-contracts) plus token-info repos; no subgraph/indexer. No community indexer found.

name: UniRouter
notes: BTC liquid-staking/bridge on B2 Network. Official org github.com/unirouter has only Solidity contract repos (unirouter-bridge-contract, unirouter-staking-contract) and a DefiLlama-Adapters fork; no subgraph/indexer. Bridge/wrapper type, low indexer likelihood.

name: Bitwise USCC
notes: Bitwise/Superstate Crypto Carry tokenized fund (USCC). Onchain infra (token issuance, transfer agent, smart contracts) operated by Superstate's FundOS; no public Superstate/Bitwise subgraph or indexer repo found. Permissioned RWA fund token.

name: SUNSwap V3
notes: Tron AMM DEX. Official org github.com/sun-protocol (25 repos) has sunswap-v3-contracts plus V2/V4 contracts, SDKs, router, but NO subgraph/indexer repo. The Graph does not support Tron; only a community python_sunswap example exists (not an indexer). No public indexer verified.

name: b14g

repos.scope: b14g Bitcoin merge-restaking / dual-staking on Core Chain
repos.verified: Found in official org github.com/b14glabs (verified via org repo listing); named b14g-core-subgraph, TypeScript, last updated ~Feb 2026 (org page). Matches the protocol's Core Chain restaking product.

notes: Official b14glabs org hosts b14g-core-subgraph (The Graph subgraph) for the Core Chain restaking deployment, alongside staking tools and a DefiLlama-Adapters fork.

name: K3 Capital
notes: Risk curator managing curated vaults across Morpho, Euler, Pendle, etc. As a curator it has no protocol of its own to index; its positions are surfaced by the underlying venues' indexers (e.g. morpho-org/morpho-positions-indexer-subgraph). No dedicated K3 public indexer repo found.

name: Saturn
notes: USDat/sUSDat stablecoin wrapper built on Strategy's STRC (ERC-4626 vault). Found contract repo (saturnlend/protocol) but no subgraph/indexer. Launched 2026; stablecoin-wrapper type, low indexer likelihood. No public indexer verified.

name: Buzz Farming
notes: Farming product on B2 (BSquared) Network, run by BSquared. No standalone github handle in dataset; no public subgraph/indexer repo found. Farm/incentive product.

name: USD AI
notes: USDai GPU/AI-hardware-backed synthetic dollar lending protocol by Permian Labs on Arbitrum. No public Permian Labs github org or subgraph/indexer repo located. No public indexer verified.

name: Defi Saver Asset Management
notes: Position manager over Maker/Aave/Compound/etc. Official org github.com/defisaver (11 repos) provides SDKs that read positions on-chain (defisaver-positions-sdk, defisaver-sdk, automation-sdk) rather than a subgraph/indexer. No subgraph repo found; positions read via SDK/RPC.

name: PumpSwap
notes: Solana AMM (pump.fun). Official pump-fun/pump-public-docs publishes program IDLs (pump_amm.json) but is docs, not an indexer. Community substreams exist (substreams.dev pumpswap packages, 0xbolt/solana-substreams) but no OFFICIAL public indexer/subgraph. Marked false (no official indexer; community-only).

name: Bitunix
notes: Centralized exchange. Custodial CEX wallets/reserves; no public EVM indexer applicable. No repo found.

name: Mantle Bridge
notes: Canonical L1<->L2 bridge. Org github.com/mantlenetworkio has only mantle-example-subgraph (forked example, testnet) and a data-transport-layer service for chain data; no production bridge-specific subgraph/indexer. Canonical bridge type. No verified protocol indexer.

name: OnRe
notes: Tokenized (re)insurance pools on Solana (ONe token). Official org github.com/onre-finance has onre-sol (Anchor Solana program) only; no subgraph/indexer repo. No public indexer found.

name: Marinade Select
notes: Solana staking-pool product by Marinade. Marinade open-sources its Solana programs/SDKs but no dedicated subgraph/indexer for the Select product; The Graph Solana support is via community substreams only. No protocol-specific public indexer verified.

name: Cooler Loans

repos.scope: Olympus Cooler Loans (loan requests, clearing, repay, default, rollover)
repos.verified: Repo contains subgraph.yaml + schema.graphql; indexes Cooler Loan contract events (loan request creation/rescission, clearing, repayment, defaulted-loan claims, rollover). Official OlympusDAO org. 78 commits, no releases; appears low-activity/stale but is the official Cooler indexer.

notes: Official OlympusDAO subgraph dedicated to the Cooler Loans product. Contract code at ohmzeus/Cooler. Subgraph stores event snapshots for frontend consumption.

name: FAssets

repos.scope: FAsset protocol (FXRP etc.) operations on Flare/Songbird/Coston
repos.verified: Official Flare Foundation repo. Custom event-based indexer ('indexing the FAsset protocol smart contract operations'); two workspaces (core scraper + NestJS API) plus price/agent watchdog. Supports coston/coston2/songbird/flare (mainnet). 710 commits, 88 releases -> actively maintained.

notes: FAssets brings non-smart-contract assets (e.g. XRP) onto Flare. Flare Foundation maintains a dedicated custom indexer (fasset-indexer). flare-labs-ltd also mirrors fassets + fasset-indexer.

name: Meteora DLMM
notes: Solana DLMM concentrated-liquidity DEX. Official org github.com/MeteoraAg has dlmm-sdk and program repos but NO indexer/subgraph. Community substreams package exists (substreams.dev/packages/meteora-dlmm by 0xMukesh) but no official public indexer. Marked false (community-only).

name: WEEX
notes: Centralized exchange. Custodial CEX; no public EVM indexer applicable. No repo found.

name: Drift Staked SOL
notes: dSOL Solana liquid-staking token by Drift. Drift open-sources protocol programs/SDK (drift-labs) but no dedicated subgraph/indexer for the dSOL stake pool; Solana indexing is community-substreams only. No protocol-specific public indexer verified.

name: Stacks sBTC
notes: 1:1 BTC-backed asset on Stacks. Public repos (stacks-sbtc/sbtc signer/protocol, stacks-archive/sbtc-developer-release) are node/signer/primitives, not a subgraph/indexer. Non-EVM (Stacks/Bitcoin) bridge; no The Graph-style indexer. No protocol indexer verified.

name: Nexus BTC
notes: Custodial BTC product by Matrixport/BIT (bit.com). Custodial bridge/wrapper; no public github org or indexer/subgraph found. Low indexer likelihood.

name: Pareto Credit
notes: Institutional private-credit / USP synthetic dollar (rebrand of Idle Finance). Current org github.com/pareto-credit (USP, governance, docs, USP contracts) has NO subgraph. Legacy Idle-Labs/idle-tranches-subgraph (subgraph.yaml+schema.graphql) indexes the OLD Idle CDO tranches and references only 'idle-finance', not Pareto/USP -> does not verifiably index the current Pareto Credit product. Marked false; legacy Idle tranches subgraph noted as the only related/historical indexer.

name: OpenTrade
notes: Stablecoin-yield RWA built on a private fork of Circle's Perimeter Protocol (circlefin/perimeter-protocol). OpenTrade's fork is maintained by Open Trade Technology Ltd but is NOT public; no OpenTrade github org or subgraph/indexer found. No public indexer verified.

name: DigiFT
notes: Regulated on-chain RWA exchange / security-token AMM (MAS/SFC licensed). No public DigiFTTech github org repositories or subgraph/indexer located. Regulated/permissioned RWA; no public indexer verified.
